A talk by Reuman on using [xsdm](../../research/xsdm/) to assess the contribution of interannual
variability to a species geographic range. See also [this preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.30.621023v2).

- [Recording on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cQOCamZTrIg&list=PLNOOSPjc9wKOJpELzF-dVLmLjNBsIAUOH&index=2)
- [The KBS seminar series](https://biosurvey.ku.edu/friday-ecology-seminars)

People: Dan Reuman
